# `aitbc prometheus rules`

List loaded Prometheus recording and alerting rules.

## Usage

```bash
aitbc prometheus rules [OPTIONS]
```

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--prometheus-url` | text | — | no | Prometheus base URL (default: http://127.0.0.1:9090) |

## Examples

```bash
aitbc prometheus rules
```
